File

The deckard.file module defines path configuration primitives used by Deckard pipelines to persist datasets, models, scores, predictions, and logs.

File path configuration utilities for Deckard experiments.

FileConfig centralizes the paths used to persist datasets, models, predictions, attack outputs, parameters, scores, and logs across the Deckard pipeline.
